sentences.zh: 今天这期《Wirecutter秀》的主题是“洗好衣服的秘诀”。

sentences.en: What are we talking about here?

sentences.en: So I'll give a couple examples.

sentences.zh: 我们做过一份登山靴指南。

sentences.en: And for that one, our writers tried out 55 pairs of boots and hiked 1,400 miles over seven years.
sentences.zh: 为了那份指南，我们的作者试穿了55双靴子，并在七年里徒步了1400英里。

sentences.zh: 我们的作者甚至专门建了一个房间，把所有这些防火保险箱放在里面烧。

sentences.en: I mean, that's the kind of lengths our journalists go to test things.

sentences.en: Committed.

sentences.en: Our recommendations are based only on what we really believe is the best stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们的推荐仅基于我们真正认为最好的产品。

sentences.en: It's a really fun place to work.

sentences.en: And I'm excited to introduce listeners here to the amazing people I work with, like Kyra.

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, we want to bring all of that to audio every week.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们想每周通过音频把这些带给大家。

sentences.en: We're going to sit down with a Wirecutter journalist and talk through a topic that we think people could use some advice on.
sentences.zh: 我们将与一位Wirecutter的记者坐下来，讨论一个我们认为人们需要建议的话题。

sentences.en: We'll give product recommendations like we always do on the site, but this is going to be a lot more than that.

sentences.en: We're going to talk through solutions, ideas, hacks, and ways that you can really make your life better.

sentences.zh: 对不起，妈妈！

sentences.en: I'm in such good company.

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: But we tested Tide Ultra Oxy, which is a powder Tide with oxygen bleach.
sentences.zh: 但我们测试了 Tide Ultra Oxy，这是一种含有氧漂白剂的汰渍洗衣粉。

sentences.en: And it did a much better job with removing things than OxyClean did.

sentences.en: I think I read in one of your guides that like the thing that really picks up stains is this thing in it called enzymes.

sentences.en: And that's what really like eats away at the stain.

sentences.en: No, for most stains, you don't need bleach.

sentences.en: I say to use oxygen bleach when it's very specific kinds of stains.
sentences.zh: 我建议在处理非常特殊的污渍时才使用氧漂白剂。

sentences.en: Like basically anything that you would use as a natural dye if you were dyeing your own clothing.
sentences.zh: 比如基本上任何如果你自己染衣服时会用到的天然染料。

sentences.en: So like tea, coffee, fruits, things where the stain really changes the fabric versus just food stains, which are pretty topical and enzymes are really good at getting those.
sentences.zh: 比如茶、咖啡、水果，这些污渍真的会改变织物的颜色，而不像普通的食物污渍，它们只是停留在表面，而酶非常擅长去除这些污渍。

sentences.en: Okay, so we can basically just throw out all of our chlorine bleach and we don't need it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以我们基本上可以扔掉所有的氯漂白剂，我们根本不需要它。

sentences.en: No, not for your regular clothes.
sentences.zh: 不，对于普通衣物来说不需要。

sentences.en: You don't need chlorine bleach, but it's still a good disinfectant.
sentences.zh: 你不需要氯漂白剂，但它仍然是一种很好的消毒剂。

sentences.en: And oxygen bleach is for the stains that are really set in and kind of changing the color of the fabric, right?
sentences.zh: 而氧漂白剂是用于那些已经深入织物并改变了颜色的顽固污渍，对吧？

sentences.en: Like wine or something?
sentences.zh: 比如红酒之类的？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Soaking in oxygen bleach will get the most stubborn stains out.
sentences.zh: 用氧漂白剂浸泡可以去除最顽固的污渍。

sentences.en: And it's great for things like wine or tea or coffee that really do soak into the fabric and are very hard to get out.
sentences.zh: 它非常适合处理像红酒、茶或咖啡这类真正渗入织物且极难去除的污渍。

sentences.en: So when you say that those like oxygen detergents are basically just hydrogen peroxide, I know there's always like a DIY community in everything.

sentences.en: When there's a product, there's a DIY product.

sentences.en: That's like a lot of DIY in general, right?
sentences.zh: 这就像大多数 DIY 项目一样，对吧？

sentences.zh: 是不是像“相似者相溶”之类的？

sentences.zh: 这是什么意思？

sentences.en: It's a solvent term.
sentences.zh: 这是一个溶剂术语。

sentences.en: Like, likes, like.
sentences.zh: 相似者相溶。

sentences.en: So, for example, when you have an oil stain, liquid detergent works really well because the surfactants and liquid detergent behave as an oil.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，当你遇到油渍时，液体洗涤剂效果很好，因为液体洗涤剂中的表面活性剂表现得像油一样。

sentences.en: So they are better absorbed into oil stains.
sentences.zh: 所以它们更容易被油渍吸收。

sentences.en: So basically, the best way to look at it is that there's water stains and there's oil stains, right?
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，最好的理解方式是，污渍分为水性污渍和油性污渍，对吧？

sentences.en: The solvents that you want to use to get rid of those stains are going to be similar in properties.
sentences.zh: 你想要用来去除这些污渍的溶剂，其性质应该是相似的。

sentences.en: So remember I said that if you're working around a lot of clay or dirt, powder detergent is better.
sentences.zh: 还记得我说过如果你经常接触粘土或泥土，粉末洗涤剂更好吗？

sentences.en: That's why.
sentences.zh: 原因就在这里。

sentences.en: It's similar, right?
sentences.zh: 它们很相似，对吧？

sentences.en: So they behave similarly and they are absorbed with each other better and combine better.
sentences.zh: 所以它们的表现相似，彼此之间更容易吸收和结合。

sentences.en: So this is why my kids like muddy, dirty clothing never gets back to like zero because it's just like I'm only using liquid.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么我孩子那些泥泞、肮脏的衣服永远洗不干净，因为我只用液体洗涤剂。

sentences.en: And so it's not it's not picking up the dirt.
sentences.zh: 所以它没能把污垢洗掉。

sentences.en: I mean, you can try pre-treating with with a liquid detergent.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可以尝试用液体洗涤剂进行预处理。

sentences.en: I find that works really well.
sentences.zh: 我发现这非常有效。

sentences.en: But you might just try powder detergent, too.
sentences.zh: 但你也可以试试粉末洗涤剂。

sentences.en: It might work.
sentences.zh: 也许会有用。

sentences.en: What exactly is the process of pre-treating?
sentences.zh: 预处理的具体过程是什么？

sentences.en: So pre-treating a stain is kind of how it sounds.
sentences.zh: 预处理污渍就像听起来那样。

sentences.en: You really are just putting the stain remover or the laundry detergent on the stain beforehand.
sentences.zh: 你实际上只是在洗涤前把去渍剂或洗衣液涂在污渍上。

sentences.en: And it's usually somewhere between five minutes to 20 minutes before you put it in the washing machine.
sentences.zh: 通常是在放入洗衣机前五到二十分钟。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: For almost every stain, if you have laundry detergent on hand, you probably can just use that for pre-treating.
sentences.zh: 对于几乎所有的污渍，如果你手头有洗衣液，你可能直接用它来预处理就行了。

sentences.en: We recommend a different stain remover, all-purpose stain remover for pre-treating called Amidex.
sentences.zh: 我们推荐一种不同的去渍剂，一种名为 Amidex 的通用去渍剂用于预处理。

sentences.en: But the reason we recommend that is because it removes other stains that laundry detergent is not always good at getting out.
sentences.zh: 但我们推荐它的原因是，它能去除洗衣液不一定能去除的其他污渍。

sentences.en: So those two are actually makeup and permanent ink.
sentences.zh: 那两种污渍实际上是化妆品和永久性墨水。

sentences.en: But otherwise, I would say you can pre-treat with laundry detergent for most stains.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，我会说对于大多数污渍，你可以用洗衣液进行预处理。

sentences.en: And then it is a good hack for laundry.
sentences.zh: 那确实是一个很好的洗衣小窍门。

sentences.en: So I don't know if any of you have ever had like a marinara stain on your shirt and you don't pre-treat it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道你们有没有过这样的经历，衬衫上沾了番茄酱，你没有进行预处理。

sentences.en: You throw it in the wash and then you come out and you still—
sentences.zh: 你直接把它扔进洗衣机，洗完出来后你仍然——

sentences.en: I've never not treated my stains.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有不处理污渍就直接洗的。

sentences.en: Not ever.
sentences.zh: 从来没有。

sentences.en: Never have I forgotten.
sentences.zh: 我从没忘记过。

sentences.en: She's lying, Your Honor.
sentences.zh: 法官大人，她在撒谎。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I mean, I will admit to you all that when we were doing laundry detergent testing
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我向大家承认，当我们进行洗衣液测试时，

sentences.en: and one of my sources told me to soak oil stains in warm water and liquid laundry detergent, I was able to get oil stains.
sentences.zh: 我的一位消息来源告诉我用温水和液体洗衣液浸泡油渍，我确实能去除油渍。

sentences.en: You know those dark oil stains you get on colorful fabric?
sentences.zh: 你知道那些在彩色织物上留下的深色油渍吗？

sentences.en: Then it'll be like the—it's just a slightly darker shade of whatever.
sentences.zh: 洗完后它会变成——只是颜色稍微深一点点。

sentences.en: I think my daughter's goal in life is to have every article of clothing have these stains.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我女儿的人生目标就是让每一件衣服都沾上这种污渍。

sentences.en: But I was able to get these stains that had been in three or four washes and dry cycles out from this soaking.
sentences.zh: 但我通过这种浸泡方法，成功去除了那些已经经过三四次洗涤和烘干循环的污渍。

sentences.en: So, you know, it's—there are a lot of different things you can do for stain removal.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，去渍有很多不同的方法。

sentences.en: Pre-treating is great, but it doesn't necessarily mean that you're totally in trouble if you still have stains coming out of the wash later.
sentences.zh: 预处理很棒，但这并不意味着如果洗完后还有污渍，你就彻底没辙了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So I've heard you mention Tide a couple times.
sentences.zh: 我听你提过几次汰渍（Tide）。

sentences.en: Why—and I think both of the powdered detergent, which is—which is that again, the one that we like?
sentences.zh: 为什么——我想两种粉末洗涤剂，哪一个是——我们喜欢的那个又是哪个？

sentences.en: Tide Ultra-Oxy.
sentences.zh: 汰渍强效活氧。

sentences.en: Tide Ultra-Oxy.
sentences.zh: 汰渍强效活氧。

sentences.en: And then the liquid we like is Tide Free and Gentle?
sentences.zh: 然后我们喜欢的液体洗涤剂是 Tide Free and Gentle？

sentences.en: Gentle and Free?
sentences.zh: 温和无添加？

sentences.en: Gentle and Free.
sentences.zh: 温和无添加。

sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why do we like Tide?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们喜欢汰渍？

sentences.en: Why is Tide such—I mean, like, we're not shilling for Tide.
sentences.zh: 为什么汰渍这么——我的意思是，我们并不是在为汰渍做广告。

sentences.en: There is no Tide commercial on this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这个播客里没有汰渍的广告。

sentences.en: So what's the deal?
sentences.zh: 所以到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: You know, it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很有趣。

sentences.en: I really went into testing wanting to not recommend Tide because I had a lot of misconceptions over being allergic to it.
sentences.zh: 我开始测试时真的不想推荐汰渍，因为我对它有过很多误解，以为自己对它过敏。

sentences.en: And then the more testing that I did and the more research I did, I learned that the ingredient that most people are allergic to in laundry detergent, it's called MI or MCI.
sentences.zh: 后来我做的测试越多，研究得越深入，我就了解到大多数人对洗衣液过敏的成分叫做 MI 或 MCI。

sentences.en: It's a chemical preservative, and it's in even, quote-unquote, natural liquid detergents.
sentences.zh: 这是一种化学防腐剂，甚至在所谓的“天然”液体洗涤剂中也含有它。

sentences.en: Almost any—all of the ones we tested contain it.
sentences.zh: 我们测试的几乎所有产品都含有它。

sentences.en: And what's interesting is that people perceive that that's what they're allergic to.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，人们认为那就是他们过敏的原因。

sentences.en: One, almost all of it's rinsed off by your washing machine.
sentences.zh: 首先，几乎所有的成分都被你的洗衣机冲洗掉了。

sentences.en: But the other is that it's the same preservative as probably in your shampoo, your shower gel, anything that you're using that needs to be preserved.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，它和你的洗发水、沐浴露以及任何你需要防腐的产品中的防腐剂是一样的。

sentences.en: So that's actually probably what's causing your allergy.
sentences.zh: 所以那实际上可能才是导致你过敏的原因。

sentences.en: I mean, we talked to multiple dermatologists about this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们为此咨询了多位皮肤科医生。

sentences.en: So that said, we partly chose Tide Free and Gentle because it doesn't have that preservative.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我们选择 Tide Free and Gentle 的部分原因是因为它不含那种防腐剂。

sentences.en: And so they had all this money and all this R&D to go into creating a laundry detergent that lacks these allergens.
sentences.zh: 所以他们投入了大量的资金和研发力量，去创造一种不含这些过敏原的洗衣液。

sentences.en: It was the combination that had hypoallergenic detergent with the fact that it removed stains so well that made it go out on top.
sentences.zh: 正是这种低过敏性洗涤剂与它出色的去渍能力相结合，才让它脱颖而出。

sentences.en: So in the end, Tide just kept—they're doing something really good there.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，汰渍一直保持领先——他们在那里确实做得很好。

sentences.en: I mean, they have a big budget, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们预算充足，对吧？

sentences.en: They have a big budget to spend on R&D, which is something that we kind of find across categories at Wirecutter that, like, we're kind of sometimes surprised.

sentences.en: But the big companies do come out ahead because they just have so much money.
sentences.zh: 但大公司确实更有优势，因为他们资金雄厚。

sentences.en: I'm kind of relieved when, like, the big names are actually doing something right because then you can get it anywhere.
sentences.zh: 当大品牌真的能做出好产品时，我反而感到欣慰，因为这样你在任何地方都能买到。

sentences.en: Like, if you run out, you don't—
sentences.zh: 比如，如果你用完了，你不需要——

sentences.en: It's very accessible.
sentences.zh: 它非常容易买到。

sentences.en: Liking niche stuff sucks.
sentences.zh: 喜欢小众产品太糟糕了。

sentences.en: It's so true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Okay, so Wirecutter recommends Tide-free and gentle liquid detergent for most laundry.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以 Wirecutter 推荐 Tide Free and Gentle 液体洗涤剂用于大多数洗衣需求。

sentences.en: For really stained stuff, dirt stained stuff, Wirecutter recommends Tide Ultra-Oxy.
sentences.zh: 对于污渍非常严重、沾满泥土的衣物，Wirecutter 推荐 Tide Ultra-Oxy。

sentences.en: And I trust these recommendations, frankly, based off all of the blood testing and stuff we discussed.
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，基于我们讨论过的所有血液测试等内容，我信任这些推荐。

sentences.en: Ooh, yes.

sentences.en: Welcome back to The Wirecutter Show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到《Wirecutter秀》。

sentences.en: Today, we're getting a master class in laundry tips from Andrea Barnes.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将跟随Andrea Barnes上一堂洗衣技巧大师课。

sentences.en: Andrea is Wirecutter's staff writer on large appliances and all things laundry.
sentences.zh: Andrea是Wirecutter负责大型家电和洗衣相关事宜的专职撰稿人。

sentences.en: So, so far, we've covered some detergent basics, but now we're going to get into some of the nitty-gritty details, literally.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经介绍了一些洗涤剂的基础知识，但现在我们要深入探讨一些细节，字面意义上的细节。

sentences.en: Okay, so what if you have really nice or vintage items like cashmere or silk?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果你有一些非常精致或复古的衣物，比如羊绒或丝绸，该怎么办呢？

sentences.en: Do you have to get those dry cleaned?
sentences.zh: 一定要送去干洗吗？

sentences.en: It's really going to depend on the item, but I would say the vast majority of the time, no.
sentences.zh: 这真的取决于衣物本身，但我可以说绝大多数情况下是不需要的。

sentences.en: First of all, you most likely can use regular detergent, Tide Free and Gentle, on a lot of your dry clean-only items if you use a mesh bag and a gentle cycle.
sentences.zh: 首先，如果你使用洗衣袋并开启轻柔模式，很多标明“仅限干洗”的衣物其实都可以使用普通的Tide Free and Gentle洗涤剂。

sentences.en: I wouldn't do this with something that you really love, but there are a few other options.

sentences.en: We recommend a hand-wash detergent called Soak, which is really great.
sentences.zh: 我们推荐一款叫Soak的手洗洗涤剂，它非常棒。

sentences.en: And what you can do is actually hand-wash your garment, and you soak the garment with this detergent, which is called Soak, and that's confusing.

sentences.en: And it's a no-rinse detergent, so you don't have to handle the clothing for that long, right?
sentences.zh: 它是一款免漂洗洗涤剂，所以你不需要长时间处理衣物，对吧？

sentences.en: So you submerge it for 15 minutes, and then you just take the item out and press the water out, and it's ready to go.
sentences.zh: 你只需将其浸泡15分钟，然后取出并挤干水分，就可以直接晾晒了。

sentences.en: The detergent evaporates really quickly.
sentences.zh: 这种洗涤剂挥发得非常快。

sentences.en: Wait, and so you don't have to rinse it?

sentences.en: The preservative we talked about earlier is not in this hand-wash detergent, which is good.
sentences.zh: 我们之前提到的防腐剂并没有添加在这种手洗洗涤剂中，这很好。

sentences.en: And then we interviewed the owner of the detergent company, and they did third-party testing that showed less than, like, 0.00005% of the residue is left on the...
sentences.zh: 我们采访了该洗涤剂公司的老板，他们的第三方测试显示，残留物不到0.00005%……

sentences.en: Because you also use a tiny amount, like, we're talking maybe two teaspoons for several gallons, so there's not much left to begin with.

sentences.en: I would say that that's ideal for, you know, if you have a cashmere sweater that you've worn a bunch of times and it hasn't really been stained, but you want it freshened up,

sentences.en: that would be a great option.
sentences.zh: 那会是一个很好的方案。

sentences.en: If it's something that's really, you got stains all over it or you bought a vintage item as is, what we learned is that the best thing to do is to use pure sodium percarbonate,

sentences.en: But pure sodium percarbonate is great for soaking your vintage iteMs.
sentences.zh: 但纯过碳酸钠非常适合浸泡复古衣物。

sentences.en: And the product we really like for that in testing is called Restoration, and it's pure oxygen bleach.
sentences.zh: 我们在测试中非常喜欢的一款产品叫Restoration，它是纯氧系漂白剂。

sentences.en: There's nothing else in it.

sentences.en: So OxyClean has fragrance and other fillers in addition to oxygen bleach, and this is just oxygen bleach.

sentences.en: How do you test these?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么测试这些产品的？

sentences.en: How are you testing, like, these vintage?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么测试这些复古衣物的？

sentences.en: So for this, we did an—I'm not going to give you my keyword search, but—
sentences.zh: 为此，我们做了一个——我不会告诉你我的关键词搜索是什么，但是——

sentences.en: To be honest with you, I don't think I want your keyword search.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我不想知道你的关键词搜索。

sentences.en: But I looked for items on eBay that are stained, and we ordered a lot of used linens that looked like they had no hope left.
sentences.zh: 但我会在eBay上寻找有污渍的商品，我们订购了许多看起来已经没救了的旧亚麻布。

sentences.en: And the craziest part—so we got this huge duvet bag filled with tablecloths and napkins and linens, and they had stains.
sentences.zh: 最疯狂的部分是——我们收到了一个装满桌布、餐巾和亚麻布的巨大羽绒袋，它们上面都有污渍。

sentences.en: But the best part slash worst part was that we realized when we opened the bag, when we unzipped it, that the person was definitely a smoker.
sentences.zh: 但最好也是最坏的部分是，当我们打开袋子、拉开拉链时，我们意识到前主人绝对是个烟民。

sentences.en: And it smelled like stale, like cigarettes, like really—yeah.
sentences.zh: 闻起来有一股陈旧的烟味，真的——是的。

sentences.en: Not a lot of competing bids.
sentences.zh: 没多少人竞价。

sentences.en: No.

sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: They were like, it's at your door.
sentences.zh: 他们就像是说，东西就在你门口。

sentences.en: Check outside.

sentences.en: We were praying you would buy this.
sentences.zh: 我们当时祈祷你会买下它。

sentences.en: So we found this, and it was all delicates, like lace and linen.
sentences.zh: 所以我们发现了这些东西，它们都是精致的织物，比如蕾丝和亚麻。

sentences.en: Again, I called a source.
sentences.zh: 同样，我咨询了一位消息人士。

sentences.en: This time, I called our source, Miki Evans, who's amazing, and she is the assistant wardrobe supervisor at The Notebook, the musical on Broadway.
sentences.zh: 这次我咨询的是Miki Evans，她非常棒，是百老汇音乐剧《恋恋笔记本》的助理服装主管。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: And, yeah, she's great, and she told me about Restoration, this oxygen bleach product that you can buy for soaking vintage iteMs.
sentences.zh: 是的，她很厉害，她向我推荐了Restoration，这是一款可以买来浸泡复古衣物的氧系漂白剂产品。

sentences.en: So we tried it against, I think, six or seven other oxygen bleaches, and this one was by far the best one.
sentences.zh: 我们拿它和其他六七种氧系漂白剂做了对比，这款绝对是最好的。

sentences.en: And we felt, because it had no fillers, was what I would call the least risky one.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，因为它没有填充剂，所以是我所说的风险最小的一款。

sentences.en: Did it take out the cigarette smell?
sentences.zh: 它能去除烟味吗？

sentences.en: It did.
sentences.zh: 能。

sentences.en: It did, yeah.
sentences.zh: 确实能，是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, and we tested a bunch of hand-washed detergents with this lot of smoky linens, and there were definitely some that did not take the stink out.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们用这批有烟味的亚麻布测试了一堆手洗洗涤剂，确实有一些没能去除异味。

sentences.en: So one thing we actually haven't gotten into is laundry pods.
sentences.zh: 我们还没讨论过洗衣凝珠。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, we got to talk about laundry pods.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，我们得聊聊洗衣凝珠。

sentences.en: We got to talk about the pods.
sentences.zh: 我们得谈谈凝珠。

sentences.en: So, Andrea, what's the deal with laundry pods?
sentences.zh: 那么，Andrea，洗衣凝珠到底怎么样？

sentences.en: And I initially didn't really want to recommend pods because you can't pre-treat with them.
sentences.zh: 起初我并不想推荐凝珠，因为你无法用它们进行预处理。

sentences.en: It's so concentrated that it actually doesn't absorb well into stains for pre-treating.
sentences.zh: 它太浓缩了，以至于无法很好地渗透进污渍进行预处理。

sentences.en: So you have to add water, and you're dealing with pod filMs.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须加水，而且还要处理凝珠的薄膜。

sentences.en: So all these things make it, like, not a great choice, in my opinion, for pre-treating.
sentences.zh: 所以在我看来，所有这些因素使得它在预处理方面并不是一个好的选择。

sentences.en: But when we started having paid testers come to the office— And let me just interject.
sentences.zh: 但当我们开始让付费测试员来到办公室时——让我插一句。

sentences.en: Paid testers are people who are not on our staff that we bring in to test with us.
sentences.zh: 付费测试员是指非我们员工的外部人员，我们请他们来一起测试。

sentences.en: And basically, they're folks who have, like, a variety of different abilities and body types.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他们是拥有不同能力和体型的人。

sentences.en: And we like to bring them in and get their feedback to get a wider diversity of opinions about the products we're testing.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢请他们来获取反馈，以便对我们测试的产品有更多元化的看法。

sentences.en: Yes, and some of whom have limited mobility and limited grip strength.
sentences.zh: 是的，其中一些人的行动能力和握力有限。

sentences.en: I observed very quickly that pods were absolutely 100% the best option for them when operating either washing machines or dishwashers.
sentences.zh: 我很快观察到，对于他们操作洗衣机或洗碗机来说，凝珠绝对是100%最好的选择。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: And so it made sense to me to make a recommendation for that.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得推荐这个是有道理的。

sentences.en: Yeah, that does make sense.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实有道理。

sentences.en: I actually had a little revelation because I don't have washer or dryer in my unit, but my partner does.
sentences.zh: 我其实有个小发现，因为我住的地方没有洗衣机或烘干机，但我伴侣那里有。

sentences.en: And whenever I go over there, it's like I've never done laundry ever in my life.
sentences.zh: 每次我去那里，都感觉自己这辈子从没洗过衣服一样。

sentences.en: I'll just toss a pod in the little compartment that they have in those washer machines.
sentences.zh: 我会直接把凝珠扔进洗衣机的小隔间里。

sentences.en: But I've learned recently that you're not supposed to do that.
sentences.zh: 但我最近才知道，你不应该那样做。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: It totally depends on the washing machine.
sentences.zh: 这完全取决于洗衣机。

sentences.en: But the way the dispenser works is that water goes through the whole thing.
sentences.zh: 但分配器的工作方式是水流会经过整个装置。

sentences.en: And if it's not a very strong stream, it can be very hard for the pod to dissolve.
sentences.zh: 如果水流不够强，凝珠就很难溶解。

sentences.en: Basically, you need the water to be strong enough to pierce the pod and start everything moving.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你需要足够强的水流来刺破凝珠并让一切开始运转。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Doing it rolling.
sentences.zh: 继续进行。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: You talked a little bit earlier about temperature.
sentences.zh: 你刚才谈到了一点温度问题。

sentences.en: And you told us earlier that you're actually supposed to be using cold water.
sentences.zh: 你之前告诉我们，实际上应该使用冷水。

sentences.en: But is there any time that you should be using warm water or hot water?
sentences.zh: 但有没有什么时候应该使用温水或热水呢？

sentences.en: I would say hot water only if you're sanitizing something.
sentences.zh: 我会说只有在需要消毒的时候才用热水。

sentences.en: Like if you had sheets from someone who was sick or if you had—
sentences.zh: 比如如果床单是生病的人用过的，或者如果你有——

sentences.en: My kids are about to potty train, for instance.
sentences.zh: 比如我的孩子快要进行如厕训练了。

sentences.en: We'll see.
sentences.zh: 到时候看看吧。

sentences.en: Now, pee stains I would say you could do in cold water because urine is pretty sterile.
sentences.zh: 尿渍的话，我觉得可以用冷水洗，因为尿液相对无菌。

sentences.en: But like a virus or something like that.
sentences.zh: 但如果是病毒之类的东西。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: I would say hot water is appropriate then.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那种情况下热水是合适的。

sentences.en: But, you know, one thing people always think, they see blood and they assume, oh, I should wash it in hot water.
sentences.zh: 但是，人们总有一个误区，看到血迹就觉得，哦，我应该用热水洗。

sentences.en: And that's actually a great way to stain your clothing more.
sentences.zh: 而这实际上是让衣服污渍加重的最好方法。

sentences.en: You absolutely need cold water for removing blood.
sentences.zh: 去除血迹绝对需要冷水。

sentences.en: Oil stains need warm water.
sentences.zh: 油渍需要温水。

sentences.en: To kind of melt the fat.
sentences.zh: 为了融化脂肪。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Well, the warm water emulsifies it, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，温水能乳化它，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, and lifts it.
sentences.zh: 是的，并将其带走。

sentences.en: What about like preserving—I mean, I know because I wash a lot of fabric to sew with.
sentences.zh: 那保护衣物呢——我是说，我知道是因为我经常洗很多布料来缝纫。

sentences.en: And I know that like I sometimes wash stuff in hot water, but I'm wondering, does that do anything to the color long term if you do wash in warm or hot water?
sentences.zh: 我知道我有时会用热水洗东西，但我很好奇，如果长期用温水或热水洗，会对颜色有影响吗？

sentences.en: Warm and hot water can definitely degrade and fade dyes faster.
sentences.zh: 温水和热水绝对会更快地降解和褪掉染料。

sentences.en: I—since I've switched to doing cold water washing, I don't see fading on my clothing in the same way that I did before.
sentences.zh: 自从我改用冷水洗涤后，我的衣服就没有出现过以前那种褪色现象了。

sentences.en: What about odor?
sentences.zh: 那异味呢？

sentences.en: Like I just—I know that you're saying like pee is okay, even blood is okay, but I just feel like the warm water will take away that smell.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的——我知道你说尿渍没问题，甚至血迹也没问题，但我总觉得温水能去除那种味道。

sentences.en: Is that totally wrong?
sentences.zh: 那是完全错误的吗？

sentences.en: Um, no, that's not wrong.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不，那并不完全错误。

sentences.en: And that's why we recommend what we do, because the liquid detergents we recommend removed odor even in cold water.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们推荐我们所推荐的产品，因为我们推荐的液体洗涤剂即使在冷水中也能去除异味。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: How do you do the odor testing?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么进行去味测试的？

sentences.en: Well, first of all, my informal odor removal testing is having a teenage son.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，我非正式的去味测试就是有一个十几岁的儿子。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, that'll do it.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的，那确实有效。

sentences.zh: 但正式测试中，我们烧了培根并使用了培根油脂，那味道真的很重。

sentences.en: It really smells terrible.
sentences.zh: 闻起来真的很糟糕。

sentences.en: And we stained T-shirts with it and then had a panel of people decide which ones removed the most and which ones smelled the worSt.
sentences.zh: 我们用它弄脏了T恤，然后让一组人来决定哪种洗涤剂去除得最干净，哪种闻起来最糟糕。

sentences.en: And in testing, the picks we made all removed that odor really well, if not entirely.
sentences.zh: 在测试中，我们挑选的产品都很好地去除了异味，甚至完全去除了。

sentences.en: Okay, now that we have fully graduated, we almost are at Ph.D.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在我们已经顺利毕业了，在去渍方面几乎达到了博士水平。

sentences.zh: 并且想在洗衣方面做出更好的选择，他们应该做些什么？

sentences.zh: 当你用热水洗涤时，洗涤周期中几乎所有的能量都用于加热水。

sentences.zh: 所以当你用冷水洗涤时，你就节省了那部分能源。

sentences.en: So when you wash in cold water, you don't use that energy.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能是你能做的最好的事情。

sentences.zh: 我会建议尽可能自然晾干。

sentences.zh: 但我会说一大桶衣服用两汤匙就够了。

sentences.zh: 非常感谢你过来。

sentences.en: Before we go, we've got one more question and we're going to ask this of all of our guests.
sentences.zh: 在结束之前，我们还有一个问题，我们要问所有的嘉宾。

sentences.en: What's one thing that you've recently bought that you really love?
sentences.zh: 你最近买的一样你非常喜欢的东西是什么？

sentences.en: It has nothing to do with laundry, but I...
sentences.zh: 这和洗衣完全没关系，但我……

sentences.en: She has other interests, guys.
sentences.zh: 大家看，她还有别的爱好呢。

sentences.en: No, you're breaking my heart.
sentences.zh: 不，你伤透了我的心。

sentences.en: I bought my husband that, the Grill Rescue grill brush that's recommended by our kitchen team.
sentences.zh: 我给丈夫买了那个我们厨房团队推荐的 Grill Rescue 烧烤刷。

sentences.en: And he really loves this grill brush.
sentences.zh: 他真的很喜欢这个烧烤刷。

sentences.en: And because he loves it, I would say it's the coolest thing I've bought recently.
sentences.zh: 因为他喜欢，所以我说这是我最近买的最酷的东西。

sentences.en: Aw, that's really nice.
sentences.zh: 噢，那真不错。

sentences.en: If you like it, I love it.
sentences.zh: 你喜欢，我就喜欢。

sentences.en: Andrea, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: Andrea，太感谢你了。

sentences.en: This has been so great.
sentences.zh: 今天真是太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们邀请我。

sentences.en: Guys, I feel like there are so many takeaways from this segment.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，我觉得这一期节目有太多的收获了。

sentences.en: I, for one, am going to go on the hunt for some powdered detergent.
sentences.zh: 我个人打算去搜罗一些洗衣粉。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.en: I actually ordered some on Amazon.com because that's where...
sentences.zh: 我其实在 Amazon.com 上订了一些，因为那是……

sentences.en: Can you repeat that?
sentences.zh: 你能再说一遍吗？

sentences.en: Amazon.com.
sentences.zh: Amazon.com.

sentences.en: I think it's the only place that I could find it.
sentences.zh: 我想那是唯一能买到的地方。

sentences.en: I thought they only sold books.
sentences.zh: 我还以为他们只卖书呢。

sentences.en: No, that's great.
sentences.zh: 不，那太棒了。

sentences.en: Okay, cool, cool.
sentences.zh: 好的，酷，酷。

sentences.en: I think my takeaway was washing cold because apparently I've been baking my cat's puke directly into my bedding.
sentences.zh: 我想我的收获是用冷水洗涤，因为显然我一直把猫的呕吐物直接烘干在我的床上用品里了。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I'm just going to win that argument with my husband because he's been doing that.
sentences.zh: 我一定要在和我丈夫的争论中赢过他，因为他一直都是那样做的。

sentences.en: So that's a win.
sentences.zh: 所以那算是一次胜利。

sentences.en: But to that point, I also think, like, you don't need to hunt around for, like, eco-friendly detergents necessarily if you're trying to be more, you know, earth-friendly.
sentences.zh: 但说到这一点，我也认为，如果你想更环保，其实没必要到处去寻找所谓的环保洗涤剂。

sentences.en: It's really just, like, energy is kind of the biggest environmental impact.
sentences.zh: 真正的问题在于，能源消耗才是最大的环境影响。

sentences.en: So washing and cold also solves that.
sentences.zh: 所以用冷水洗涤也能解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And then, like, you don't have to go out and hunt for a fancy pretreatment.
sentences.zh: 而且，你也不必特意去寻找什么花哨的预处理剂。

sentences.en: Like, your laundry detergent that you already have will do just fine.
sentences.zh: 你现有的洗衣液就完全够用了。

sentences.en: Use what you got.
sentences.zh: 用你手头有的就行。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Wash cold.
sentences.zh: 用冷水洗。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think that, like, you really can just get, like, two detergents essentially, a liquid and a powder, and you're probably, like, 95% of the way there.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你真的只需要准备两种洗涤剂，一种液体，一种粉末，基本上就能解决 95% 的问题了。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 完美。

sentences.en: Andrea was a star.
sentences.zh: Andrea 真是太出色了。

sentences.en: She was amazing.
sentences.zh: 她太棒了。

sentences.en: I really hope that I can apply this, you know, when I have a machine in my apartment again.
sentences.zh: 我真希望等我公寓里再有洗衣机的时候，能用上这些知识。

sentences.en: I really hope I can get the dirt stains out of my kids' clothes finally.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我终于能把我孩子们衣服上的泥渍洗掉了。

sentences.en: Godspeed, my friends.
sentences.zh: 祝你们好运，朋友们。

sentences.en: And that's it for us this week.
sentences.zh: 本周节目就到这里。

sentences.zh: 如果你想了解更多关于 Wirecutter 对洗衣液的测评，或者购买我们今天推荐的产品，

sentences.zh: 请访问 nytimes.com/Wirecutter 或查看节目说明中的链接。

sentences.en: So if you like the Wirecutter show, which we all hope you do, right?
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢 Wirecutter 节目，我们都希望你喜欢，对吧？

sentences.en: I think people are actually going to listen to this.
sentences.zh: 我觉得大家真的会听这个节目的。

sentences.en: I hope so.
sentences.zh: 希望如此。

sentences.en: I hope people are listening right now.
sentences.zh: 希望现在就有人在听。

sentences.en: And if they're listening, maybe they'll follow us.
sentences.zh: 如果他们在听，也许他们会关注我们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Or leave a review.
sentences.zh: 或者留个评论。

sentences.en: A hopefully nice one.
sentences.zh: 希望是条好评。

sentences.en: We'll always read the reviews.
sentences.zh: 我们一定会读评论的。

sentences.en: Even if it's mean, I guess.
sentences.zh: 哪怕是恶评，我想也是。

sentences.en: It also helps other people find the show.
sentences.zh: 这也有助于其他人发现我们的节目。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: For sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening either way.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，感谢收听。
